model: CLEV-DR (local name; the paper calls it Ours-DR)

paper.title: Addressing Correlated Latent Exogenous Variables in Debiased Recommender Systems

missing_from_repository: matrix_factorization_noisy_ori.py (imported by new_model.py; its helpers exist in utils.py)

parity: Same seed, real Coat, 2 IPS + 3 fit epochs: author MF_BV_Multi_bin_JL_G_DR (cuda calls made no-ops) and CLEVDR give max |prediction difference| 0.0 and identical rho (docs/archive/2026-11-04/mrdr_cal_clev/clev_parity.log)
from_source: Four NCF towers 2k -> k -> k -> 1 (prediction g_y, selection g_o, IPS propensity, imputation), rho = tanh(rho_v)
_compute_IPS: propensity tower regresses the observation indicator on all pairs with MSE, tol-based stopping
fit: Monte Carlo bivariate-probit likelihood (y_loss, o_loss), DR squared-error loss with clipped inverse propensity (gamma 0.015) and imputation loss, alpha * y_loss + (1 - alpha) * DR loss
Stopping: relative epoch-loss change below tol counted 7 times, at most 1000 epochs
Hyperparameters hard-coded in coat_test.py, yahoo_main.py, kuai_main.py; alpha swept by bash/*.sh (--sigma_y)
Labels: Coat/Yahoo rating >= 3 positive; NDCG@K = 1 for users without positives; recall / max(1, #positives); global AUC
local_choices: Coat uses the coat_test.py (Naive) hyperparameters with the DR class, because coat_test_dr.py is missing
Yahoo rows are shuffled after seeding; the author script shuffles at import time, before setup_seed
AUC is computed with average ranks (same value as sklearn roc_auc_score), sklearn is not a project dependency
Each alpha of the bash sweep is run for every seed and reported; choosing an alpha uses test metrics, as the author procedure does

KuaiRand-Pure replaces the KuaiRec data of the paper (the thesis uses KuaiRand-Pure for every model): standard logs = biased training log, random log = test, target is_click, ids mapped jointly, repeated (user, video) rows merged (clicked if any row is a click)
KuaiRand-Pure has no author configuration: kuai_main.py (KuaiRec) values with the Yahoo propensity batch 204800 and tolerance 1e-3, K = 5, alpha sweep of bash/kuai_main.sh
KuaiRand-Pure uses CLEVDRLarge: no |U| x |I| arrays (the author layout needs ~33 GB); same random stream, exact parity with CLEVDR on Coat and in tests/test_clev.py
For each seed the IPS stage is trained once and its model and random state are restored for every alpha; tests show this equals separate runs
known_paper_code_differences: The Optuna objective of every script maximises test AUC + NDCG + Recall, so the published hyperparameters were selected on the test set
paper_comparison: Paper Table 2 has Coat, Yahoo! R3 and KuaiRec; KuaiRand-Pure has no paper number
